leads.name: github.com/pingcap/tidb/parser

leads.name: vitess.io/vitess/go/vt/sqlparser
leads.reason: sqlparser.NewTestParser().Parse / Parser.Parse return an AST Statement (Select, Insert) for MySQL-dialect text.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/parser
leads.reason: Archived standalone TiDB parser module; parser.New().Parse returns []ast.StmtNode. Superseded by github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser. Checked 2026-11-17: the newest tagged module v3.1.2+incompatible has no test_driver package, so literal values need the parser_driver from the full TiDB module; a standalone harness was not built. Remains a lead.

leads.name: github.com/xwb1989/sqlparser
leads.reason: 2018 extraction of vitess go/vt/sqlparser (untagged; pinned to pseudo-version 120387863bf2). Not byte-identical to the selected vitess v0.24.5 sqlparser: 0 of 12 same-named non-test source files identical, 23.9% of its 19,192 lines in matching blocks. SplitStatementToPieces and Parse give the oracle summary on both controls; selected as a separate path in the vitess family.

leads.name: github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser
leads.reason: Current TiDB parser module (no tagged releases; pinned to the snapshot's proxy pseudo-version of commit 1e84b3595a3e). parser.New().Parse with the documented test_driver package returns ast.StmtNode values that give the oracle summary on both controls; Go coverpkg covers the parser package and the AFL++ bridge differs between the controls.

leads.name: github.com/blastrain/vitess-sqlparser/sqlparser
leads.reason: vitess sqlparser fork with a TiDB-parser fallback; shared vitess family.

leads.name: github.com/pganalyze/pg_query_go/v6
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: cgo binding to libpg_query; pg_query.Parse returns the PostgreSQL protobuf parse tree.

leads.name: github.com/auxten/postgresql-parser/pkg/sql/parser
leads.reason: Extracted CockroachDB parser; parser.Parse returns tree.Statement values.

leads.name: github.com/cockroachdb/cockroachdb-parser/pkg/sql/parser
